# **Detailed INEN Dataset**

The purpose of this code is to do the ingestion and cleaning of the subdataset, that was extracted from the INEN dataset but it contains more detailes on each case.

**Download dataset and libraries**

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
```

```{r}
#import datase, I especifically calling 31 columns 
detailed_inen <- read_excel(
  file.choose(),
  range = cell_cols("A:AE")
)

```

Inspect dataset

```{r}
head(detailed_inen)
```

```{r}
str(detailed_inen)
```

What it needs to be fixed on this dataset is:

1. Remove the one blank row
2. Reformatting variables name 
3. Create one extra grouped stage variable (I, II, II, IV) so it will be easier to analyze.
4. Standarize all tumor size data into centimeters.
5. Clean follow-up months into numeric form.


### 1. Removing blank row

```{r}
detailed_clean <- detailed_inen |>
  filter(if_any(everything(), ~ !is.na(.)))
```

### 2. Fixing the variables titles

```{r}
detailed_clean <- detailed_clean |>
  rename(
    AGE_AT_DIAGNOSIS = `AGE (at diagnosis)`,
    CLINICAL_STAGE = `DISEASE STAGE (CLINICAL STAGE)`,
    TUMOR_SIZE = `TUMOR SIZE`,
    TUMOR_GRADE = `TUMOR GRADE`,
    DX_DATE = `DX DATE`,
    LAST_FOLLOW_UP_DATE = `Last FU DATE`,
    FOLLOW_UP_MONTHS = `FOLLOW UP (MONTHS)`,
    LYMPH_NODE_METASTASIS = `REGIONAL/ REMOTE LN METASTASIS`)

```

```{r}
names(detailed_clean)
```
### 3. Create simplified clinical Stage variable 

```{r}
detailed_clean <- detailed_clean %>%
  mutate(STAGE_GROUP = case_when(
      grepl("^IV", CLINICAL_STAGE) ~ "IV",
      grepl("^III", CLINICAL_STAGE) ~ "III",
      grepl("^II", CLINICAL_STAGE) ~ "II",
      grepl("^I", CLINICAL_STAGE) ~ "I",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_))

table(detailed_clean$STAGE_GROUP, useNA = "ifany")
```

### 4. Standarized Tumor Size to CM

```{r}
# Checking how the size is presented
detailed_clean$TUMOR_SIZE <- as.character(detailed_clean$TUMOR_SIZE)
detailed_clean$TUMOR_SIZE
```
```{r}
# Reformatting everything to CM
detailed_clean$TUMOR_SIZE <- ifelse(
  grepl("MM", detailed_clean$TUMOR_SIZE, ignore.case = TRUE),
  as.numeric(sub(" .*", "", detailed_clean$TUMOR_SIZE)) / 10,
  as.numeric(sub(" .*", "", detailed_clean$TUMOR_SIZE)))
detailed_clean$TUMOR_SIZE

```

### 5.Clean Follow-up Months
```{r}
detailed_clean <- detailed_clean |>
  mutate(FOLLOW_UP_MONTHS = as.numeric(str_extract(as.character(FOLLOW_UP_MONTHS), "[0-9.]+")))
```


Final Checks n digestion process

```{r}
dim(detailed_clean)
```
```{r}
colSums(is.na(detailed_clean))
```

Export clean dataset

```{r}
write_csv(
  detailed_clean,
  "inen_detailed_subset.csv")
```
